_pair_unit: one dominant PARTY, one vote per distinct weapon pair it fields; a pair needs min_pair_parties parties across min_pair_orgs distinct guild-sets; s = clamp(log2 lift, 0, log_cap)/log_cap * n/(n+K); lift <= 1 reads 0

_split.rule: battle % 5 != 0 (training split; % 5 == 0 is the v4h holdout)

_unit: the dominant killer party of the pool's size in the content (no deaths, a kill, every weapon known and in the catalog); solo: distinct players per weapon (one player, one vote), share of the pool's voters, shrunk n/(n+K), normalized so the pool's top weapon is 1.0, rows under min_prior omitted (no signal, never a penalty)
